exam_scheme.note: NEET-MDS is the single national eligibility-cum-ranking entrance examination for admission to Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) and PG Diploma dental courses across government, deemed, and private dental colleges in India, conducted by NBEMS under the Dentists Act, 1948 and DCI regulations. The examination is administered as a single Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of 240 multiple-choice questions carrying 960 marks with a duration of 3 hours (180 minutes). The syllabus is divided into Part A (100 questions) covering general medical sciences and Part B (140 questions) covering core dental surgery disciplines. Marking scheme: 4 marks for each correct response, deduction of 1 mark for each incorrect response (25% negative marking). Qualifying criteria: 50th percentile for General/EWS, 40th percentile for SC/ST/OBC, and 45th percentile for UR-PwD.
